Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer introduced unverified, assumed annual pass prices ($150 per adult, $75 per student) instead of retrieving the actual Philadelphia Museum of Art membership rates. This incorrect assumption inflated the annual-pass total and led to the erroneous conclusion (-$5) rather than the correct savings ($395). The mistake originated from using guessed prices rather than verified data (and not considering the appropriate membership structure), which directly caused the wrong final answer.
